name: Koborah
description: A Sun priest who bound Illith and was pushed through the Hellgate.

timeline.summary: Helana rescues her father from Hell, but the Archduke dies and she becomes half-dark and gives up her priesthood.
timeline.quote: She has to give up her priesthood and walk away from her father and parish

citation.text: "Distant Planes", section "Dual Loyalties , by Glen Vasey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koborah was whisked away by Gerheart's summoning before teaching Helana all the Sun-stones' uses.

citation.text: "Helana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helana and Illith tricked the Archduke's servants into releasing Koborah, and she returned with him and Rorsa; the Archduke's misfired spell killed him.
timeline.quote: she and Illith tricked the servants of the Archduke

citation.text: "Helana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helana helps Illith return to hell and recovers her father Koborah.
timeline.quote: Koborah's daughter Helana helped Illith to return to hell, and recovered her father

citation.text: "Hell", section "Early lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Illith is pulled into a duel between Gerheart and his enemy; Koborah binds him with holy magic.
timeline.quote: the Sun priest Koborah bound him with holy magic

timeline.summary: A Fireball pushes Koborah through the Hellgate, stranding Illith.
timeline.quote: leaving Illith stranded on the unnamed plane of white, green, and blue mana
